originality.rationale: The motivating paper conjectures this numerical k=2 specialization; its general fixed-f claim is false as worded, and its proof only establishes a differently quantified statement. The positive Liouville sign, exact zero locus and parity law are not in the original paper. Full-text checks of both closest published findings show no implication of this theorem. Extensive targeted query searches found no equivalent or stronger covering source, but an unindexed equivalent remains a risk.
